entries.1be7155a59a3af0b: Operation of route buses, highway buses and chartered buses
entries.367270508685ac18: It arranges, plans and sells travel within Japan. It handles tours to Okinawa and tours to the Kansai area timed to the Osaka-Kansai Expo, among others.
entries.373202ac2b9c49c2: Operation of the large commercial facility “Sakuramachi Kumamoto”
entries.3b77f37f2bdf1295: It arranges, plans and sells travel from Japan to overseas destinations. It handles escorted tours and products that allow customers to freely combine overseas air tickets and hotels, among others.
entries.434b3d9dd65fc932: Reception of inbound travel to Japan
entries.46d93c76574aafa7: Planning and arrangement of travel for corporate clients
entries.46ff04c82dc624f7: This is the core business of the group, covering the arrangement, planning and sale of overseas and domestic travel, along with related ancillary businesses. It has a network of 149 locations in Japan and 141 locations in 110 cities across 58 countries overseas (as of the end of October 2025). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥307,976 million.
entries.49274b78bf937395: Products combining overseas air tickets and hotels
entries.c0d406217dc8fe2e: This business operates hotels in Japan, Taiwan, the United States, Turkey and other countries. It operates brands including “Henn na Hotel” and “Watermark Hotel.” Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥24,734 million.
entries.c2342c0994737c0c: Planning, arrangement and sale of overseas travel
entries.d3acc1957fd56470: Planning, arrangement and sale of domestic travel
entries.e0d04a95fb41de0f: This is the business of the group whose holding company is Kyushu Sangyo Kotsu Holdings Co., Ltd. Based in Kumamoto Prefecture, it operates automobile transportation businesses, including route buses, highway buses and chartered buses, as well as real estate leasing, including operation of the large commercial facility “Sakuramachi Kumamoto.” Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥25,355 million.
entries.e9dbf1e0047487c8: This is a category of businesses not included in reportable segments. It owns and operates the theme park “Laguna Ten Bosch” in Gamagori, Aichi Prefecture; runs a non-life insurance business centered on overseas travel insurance; develops and operates room reservation systems; and carries out infrastructure businesses, such as facility management and machinery installation and maintenance work. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥15,039 million.
entries.eeb0fb7f2ebf3840: A major travel company handling overseas and domestic travel, whose group also operates hotels and theme parks and runs a bus business in Kyushu.
